column1: # npm-pre-scan evaluation corpus — LOCAL DUMMY PACKAGES
# Purpose : ground-truth fixtures authored by this project, one per in-scope
# Source  : dummy_packages/ (GITIGNORED and untracked — this file is the only
#           written record of which dirs must exist and what each one targets).
#           Vector assignments derived from CLAUDE.md's "Dummy Packages —
#           verification status" table and the assertions in tests/*.rs.
# Format  : tab-separated. Lines starting with # are comments; blank lines skipped.
#           kind  id  group  label  vectors  layers  note
#           kind   ∈ name | version | dir | holder | sample
#           vectors: comma-separated A1..E1 / META, or - for none/unknown
#           layers : comma-separated subset of 0,1,2,3, or - for none
#           note   : optional free text, echoed into the record
# NOTE on `dir` entries: Layer 0 is never applicable (a local directory has no
# registry identity — matching run_full_local). A missing directory is recorded
# as `skipped_missing` and excluded from every metric denominator, so this file
# stays usable on a fresh clone where dummy_packages/ does not exist.
# --- name-only fixtures (no directory; Layer 0 name checks only) -------------
